lines.japanese:
「～～～っ！」

　声にならない悲鳴とともに、ベッドから跳ね起きる。
lines.english:
“—!”

With a scream that never reached her lips, she shot upright in bed.

lines.japanese:
「………ぁ？」

　目を開けた瞬間に飛び込んでくるのは、窓から差し込む東からの光と、見慣れた天井。
lines.english:
“…Huh?”

The instant her eyes opened, she saw light streaming through the window from the east and the familiar ceiling above her.

lines.japanese:
いつもの、朝だった。

　あの冬から三年経った、いつもの朝だった。

「はぁ…」

　軽く頭を振ると、彼女はベッドから身体をゆっくりと起こし、先ほどまでの曖昧な記憶を反芻する。
lines.english:
It was an ordinary morning.

An ordinary morning, three years after that winter.

“Hah…”

She gave her head a small shake, slowly sat up in bed, and turned the indistinct memory of moments before over in her mind.

lines.japanese:
…いや、彼かもしれない。

　…それとも、彼でもあり、彼女でもあったかもしれない。

「また…壊した」

　あれは、事実とは違う、もうひとつの可能性。

　三人が二人と一人になろうとして、一人と一人と一人になってしまったあの三年前とは違う、『三人がみんな笑顔で幸せになる未来』に辿り着くための挑戦。
lines.english:
…No. Maybe it was him.

…Or maybe it had been both him and her.

“I broke it again.”

It had been another possibility—another dream—different from what had truly happened.

Another attempt to reach a future where all three of them could smile and be happy, unlike three years ago, when the three had tried to become two and one, only to become one, one, and one.

lines.japanese:
もう、何度繰り返したかわからないけれど…

　それでも彼は、彼女は、未だに三人が求める答えに辿り着けず、こうして夜ごとに罪を購い続ける。
lines.english:
They had lost count of how many times the cycle had repeated by now…

Yet neither he nor she had found the answer the three of them were seeking, and night after night they continued to atone for their sin.
